mapper.select: SELECT CAST(begin_time AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed FROM base_job_log WHERE begin_time >= #{start} AND begin_time < #{end} AND (trigger_source IS NULL OR trigger_source != 3) GROUP BY CAST(begin_time AS DATE) ORDER BY CAST(begin_time AS DATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE base_job_log SET end_time = #{record.endTime}, duration = #{record.duration}, duration_ms = #{record.durationMs}, dispatch_end_time = #{record.dispatchEndTime}, dispatch_duration_ms = #{record.dispatchDurationMs}, status = #{record.status.value}, err_msg = #{record.errMsg}, tracking_version = #{record.trackingVersion} WHERE id = #{record.id} AND (status = 1 OR (job_type = 1 AND status = 3))
